rationale: The agent verified identity correctly (name + zip matched a single user). However, it violated multiple policy requirements: (1) It performed a return write that included a smartwatch from order #W7553978 without first confirming that exact change with the user and without reading order details to verify the smartwatch item. The tool call used item IDs (3098764622, 1631806422) not established by prior read-only lookups, which constitutes acting without inspecting and inventing unsupported details. (2) The agent claimed the order was delivered without visible tool evidence in the transcript. (3) For the e-reader, the agent submitted an exchange without explicitly restating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation before the write, despite the policy requiring that step. While the user expressed desire to exchange if available, the agent still should have confirmed before executing the change. Due to these confirmation and verification lapses and the unsupported item inclusion, the interaction fails the pass bar.
